items.title: US-Israel War on Iran Dramatically Expands Across Middle East
items.title_zh: 美以聯合攻擊伊朗，中東戰爭急劇升級
items.desc: The war in the Middle East triggered by the joint US and Israeli attack on Iran expanded dramatically on Monday, with casualties and destruction reported across at least nine countries, including major strikes on Tehran.
items.desc_zh: 週一，美國和以色列聯合攻擊伊朗引發的中東戰爭急劇升級，至少有九個國家報告傷亡和破壞，包括對德黑蘭的重大襲擊。

items.title: Trump Vows to 'Avenge' Deaths of US Service Members in Iran Strikes
items.title_zh: 特朗普誓言為伊朗襲擊中喪生的美軍報仇
items.desc: President Trump said the US military operation against Iran could continue for four to five weeks, with the US having capability to go far longer if needed.
items.desc_zh: 特朗普總統表示，美國對伊朗的軍事行動可能持續四到五週，如有需要，美國有能力持續更長時間。

items.title: Ukraine to Complete EU Accession Technical Work Within Days
items.title_zh: 烏克蘭將在數日內完成加入歐盟的技術工作
items.desc: President Zelensky announced Ukraine will complete technical work needed to open negotiations on all topics for its European Union accession process within days.
items.desc_zh: 澤連斯基總統宣布，烏克蘭將在數日內完成開啟歐盟入盟談判所需的所有技術工作。

items.title: UK Vows to 'Make 2026 the Year War Ends' in Ukraine
items.title_zh: 英國誓言讓2026年成為烏克蘭戰爭結束之年
items.desc: The UK defence secretary said Britain will deploy troops to Ukraine and is determined to make 2026 the year the war with Russia ends.
items.desc_zh: 英國國防大臣表示，英國將向烏克蘭派遣軍隊，並決心讓2026年成為與俄羅斯戰爭結束的一年。

items.title: Elon Musk Leaves Trump Administration, DOGE Project Disbanded
items.title_zh: 馬斯克離開特朗普政府，DOGE項目解散
items.desc: Tesla CEO Elon Musk has left the Trump administration and his role in DOGE, the body tasked with reducing US government spending. The initiative claimed to have cut only a fraction of the promised $1 trillion.
items.desc_zh: 特斯拉CEO馬斯克已離開特朗普政府及其在DOGE（負責削減美國政府開支的機構）的職位。該計劃聲稱僅削減了承諾的1萬億美元中的一小部分。

items.title: China's Two Sessions to Convene March 4-11, 15th Five-Year Plan in Focus
items.title_zh: 中國兩會將於3月4-11日召開，聚焦第15個五年計劃
items.desc: China's annual Two Sessions will convene in Beijing, with the CPPCC opening on March 4 and the NPC beginning on March 5. The focal point will be the Government Work Report and the draft 15th Five-Year Plan.
items.desc_zh: 中國年度兩會將在北京召開，全國政協會議3月4日開幕，全國人大會議3月5日開始。焦點將是政府工作報告和第15個五年計劃草案。

items.title: China's Youth Unemployment Eases to 16.9% as Graduates Settle for Less
items.title_zh: 中國青年失業率降至16.9%，畢業生降低期望就業
items.desc: The jobless rate for those aged 16 to 24, excluding students, fell to 16.9% in November from 17.3% in October. China braces for a record 12.7 million graduates entering the tight job market in 2026.
items.desc_zh: 16-24歲（不含學生）失業率從10月的17.3%降至11月的16.9%。2026年將有創紀錄的1270萬畢業生進入緊張的就業市場。

items.title: China's Chip Industry to Advance AI Design Despite US Restrictions
items.title_zh: 中國芯片產業將在AI設計領域取得進展，儘管面臨美國限制
items.desc: Chinese firms will advance in AI chip design and manufacturing despite restrictions, with companies like Huawei and SMIC increasing production. Four Chinese chip startups have gone public or filed to.
items.desc_zh: 儘管面臨限制，中國企業將在AI芯片設計和製造領域取得進展，華為和中芯國際等公司正在增加產量。四家中國芯片初創公司已上市或提交申請。

items.title: China's DeepSeek Trained AI Model on Nvidia's Best Chip Despite US Ban
items.title_zh: 儘管美國禁令，中國DeepSeek仍使用英偉達頂級芯片訓練AI模型
items.desc: US government confirmation of DeepSeek obtaining Nvidia chips could further divide Washington policymakers. White House AI Czar and Nvidia CEO argue shipping advanced chips to China discourages Chinese competitors.
items.desc_zh: 美國政府確認DeepSeek獲得英偉達芯片，可能進一步分化華盛頓政策制定者。白宮AI主管和英偉達CEO認為向中國運送先進芯片會阻礙中國競爭對手。

items.title: China's Property Crisis Continues Into 2026 as Vanke Proposes Payment Delay
items.title_zh: 中國房地產危機持續至2026年，萬科提議延期付款
items.desc: China Evergrande was ordered to liquidate after failing to present a viable restructuring plan. Giant developer China Vanke shocked markets by proposing a delay in making a payment on a local bond.
items.desc_zh: 中國恒大因未能提出可行的重組計劃而被下令清盤。大型開發商萬科提議延期支付本地債券，震驚市場。

items.title: China's Four AI Chip 'Dragons' - Moore Threads, MetaX, Biren, Enflame
items.title_zh: 中國AI芯片'四龍'：摩爾線程、沐曦、壁仞、燧原
items.desc: Four Chinese chip startups dubbed China's 'four dragons' have gone public or filed to: Moore Threads, MetaX, Biren, and Enflame. They aim to challenge Nvidia's dominance in AI chips.
items.desc_zh: 被稱為中國'四龍'的四家芯片初創公司已上市或提交申請：摩爾線程、沐曦、壁仞、燧原。它們旨在挑戰英偉達在AI芯片領域的主導地位。

items.title: Hong Kong Budget 2026-27: Property Prices Rose 3.3%, Ending Three-Year Decline
items.title_zh: 香港2026-27年度預算：樓價上升3.3%，結束三年跌勢
items.desc: The Hong Kong government announced that property prices rose by 3.3% for the year, ending a three-year decline, while rental prices rose by 4.3%. Total transactions reached a four-year high of nearly 63,000.
items.desc_zh: 香港政府宣布，全年樓價上升3.3%，結束三年跌勢，租金上升4.3%。全年總成交量達到近63,000宗，創四年新高。

items.title: Hong Kong Home Prices Expected to Rise 3-5% in 2026
items.title_zh: 香港樓價預計2026年上升3-5%
items.desc: Hong Kong home prices are expected to rise by around 3% to 5% in 2026, amidst a 'wealth effect' driven by an active stock market. More buyers are actively entering the market.
items.desc_zh: 受活躍股市帶來的'財富效應'推動，香港樓價預計2026年將上升約3-5%。更多買家正積極進入市場。

items.title: Hong Kong Budget: Government Unveils New Measures to Boost REIT Market
items.title_zh: 香港預算案：政府推出新措施提振REIT市場
items.desc: The Hong Kong government and the Securities and Futures Commission will continue to drive high-quality development of the Real Estate Investment Trust (REIT) market.
items.desc_zh: 香港政府及證券及期貨事務監察委員會將繼續推動房地產投資信託(REIT)市場的高質量發展。

items.title: Hang Seng Index Target of 28,300 by Year-End 2026 on Track
items.title_zh: 恒生指數2026年底目標28,300點進展順利
items.desc: Early performance suggests the base case target of 28,300 for the Hang Seng Index by year-end 2026 is firmly on track. The HK50 fell to 26,083 points on March 2, losing 2.06%.
items.desc_zh: 早期表現顯示，恒生指數2026年底目標28,300點的基本情況預測進展順利。3月2日HK50跌至26,083點，下跌2.06%。

items.title: Hong Kong to Adjust HK$2 Transport Subsidy Scheme from April 2026
items.title_zh: 香港將於2026年4月起調整2元乘車優惠計劃
items.desc: Hong Kong will require elderly passengers to pay 20% of fares surpassing HK$10 under the HK$2 transport subsidy scheme, implemented in April 2026, five months earlier than planned.
items.desc_zh: 香港將要求長者在2元乘車優惠計劃下支付超過10港元車費的20%，於2026年4月實施，比計劃提前五個月。

sections.title: 📈 港股關注 - 萬國數據 GDS

items.title: GDS Holdings Stock Price at HK$44.72, Down 8.55% from 52-Week High
items.title_zh: 萬國數據股價44.72港元，較52周高點下跌8.55%
items.desc: GDS Holdings Ltd (9698:HKG) closed at HK$44.72, down 8.55% below its 52-week high. The company is a leading developer and operator of high-performance data centers in China.
items.desc_zh: 萬國數據(9698.HK)收於44.72港元，較52周高點下跌8.55%。該公司是中國領先的高性能數據中心開發商和運營商。

items.title: GDS to Sell Data Centers to New REIT in $400 Million Deal
items.title_zh: 萬國數據以4億美元向新REIT出售數據中心
items.desc: GDS announced a breakthrough deal for its asset monetization program, selling a 100% equity interest in certain data center project companies to a private REIT at an implied EV to EBITDA multiple of around 13 times.
items.desc_zh: 萬國數據宣布其資產變現計劃取得突破性進展，向私人REIT出售某些數據中心項目公司的100%股權，隱含企業價值/息稅折舊攤銷前利潤比率約為13倍。

items.title: GDS Completes C-REIT IPO on Shanghai Stock Exchange at RMB 3.00 Per Unit
items.title_zh: 萬國數據完成中國REIT上海證券交易所IPO，每股3元人民幣
items.desc: GDS announced the successful completion of its China REIT (C-REIT) initial public offering on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, with a final offering price of RMB 3.00 per unit.
items.desc_zh: 萬國數據宣布其中國REIT(C-REIT)首次公開發行在上海證券交易所成功完成，最終發售價為每股3元人民幣。

items.title: GDS First Ever Monetization of Data Center Assets in China Through Private REIT
items.title_zh: 萬國數據通過私人REIT完成中國數據中心資產首次變現
items.desc: GDS entered into definitive agreements to monetize a 70% equity interest in certain data centers at an implied enterprise value to EBITDA multiple of around 13 times.
items.desc_zh: 萬國數據簽訂最終協議，以約13倍的企業價值/息稅折舊攤銷前利潤比率變現某些數據中心70%的股權。

items.title: Analysts Rate GDS Holdings 'Outperform' with Average Recommendation of 1.8
items.title_zh: 分析師給予萬國數據'跑贏大市'評級，平均推薦值為1.8
items.desc: 18 brokerage firms have collectively rated GDS Holdings Ltd with an average brokerage recommendation of 1.8, meaning the stock is currently classified as 'Outperform.'
items.desc_zh: 18家券商共同給予萬國數據平均1.8的推薦值，意味著該股票目前被評為'跑贏大市'。

items.title: OpenClaw Patch Prevents Malicious Websites From Hijacking AI Agents
items.title_zh: OpenClaw發布補丁，防止惡意網站劫持AI代理
items.desc: OpenClaw had a vulnerability chain that allowed websites to take control of a developer's agent with no plugins, extensions or user interaction required. A patch has been released.
items.desc_zh: OpenClaw存在一個漏洞鏈，允許網站在無需插件、擴展或用戶交互的情況下控制開發者的代理。現已發布補丁。

items.title: OpenClaw Creator Peter Steinberger Joins OpenAI
items.title_zh: OpenClaw創始人Peter Steinberger加入OpenAI
items.desc: Peter Steinberger, who created the AI personal assistant now known as OpenClaw, has joined OpenAI. Sam Altman said Steinberger will 'drive the next generation of personal agents.'
items.desc_zh: 現稱為OpenClaw的AI個人助理的創始人Peter Steinberger已加入OpenAI。Sam Altman表示Steinberger將'推動下一代個人代理的發展'。

items.title: Anthropic's Claude Surges to No.1 on App Store After Pentagon Blacklist
items.title_zh: 五角大樓封殺後，Anthropic的Claude躍居App Store榜首
items.desc: Claude climbed to the No.1 spot on Apple's chart of top free apps, dethroning ChatGPT, just one day after the Pentagon tapped OpenAI for classified military networks.
items.desc_zh: 就在五角大樓選擇OpenAI為機密軍事網絡提供AI服務的一天後，Claude攀升至蘋果免費應用榜首，取代ChatGPT。

items.title: Apple Announces March 2026 Launch Spree with Personalized Siri Expected
items.title_zh: 蘋果宣布2026年3月新品發布潮，個性化Siri備受期待
items.desc: Apple CEO Tim Cook confirmed a week of product announcements in March 2026. The launch of Personalized Siri is highly likely, given the recent partnership with Google to leverage Gemini models.
items.desc_zh: 蘋果CEO庫克確認2026年3月將有一週的新品發布。鑑於最近與谷歌合作利用Gemini模型，個性化Siri的推出可能性很高。

items.title: Cambricon Targets 500,000 AI Chips in 2026 as China Accelerates Hardware Push
items.title_zh: 寒武紀目標2026年生產50萬AI芯片，中國加速國產硬件推進
items.desc: Cambricon aims to deliver around 500,000 AI accelerators in 2026, including as many as 300,000 units of its Siyuan 590 and 690 processors.
items.desc_zh: 寒武紀目標在2026年交付約50萬個AI加速器，其中包括多達30萬個思元590和690處理器。

items.title: J.P. Morgan Sees 35% Probability of US and Global Recession in 2026
items.title_zh: 摩根大通預計2026年美國和全球經濟衰退概率為35%
items.desc: J.P. Morgan Global Research sees a 35% probability of a U.S. and global recession in 2026. The Fed is not expected to start easing until December.
items.desc_zh: 摩根大通全球研究預計2026年美國和全球經濟衰退概率為35%。預計美聯儲要到12月才開始寬鬆政策。
